task_description: In this multi-agent scenario, three agents collaborate to handle a customer service request. Agent 1 is responsible for initial inquiry handling and contextual data gathering. Agent 2 specializes in resolving standard customer issues and escalating complex ones. Agent 3 tracks and closes tickets, ensuring that the resolution is communicated back to the customer. The agents need to maintain seamless context sharing and ticket status synchronization.
expected_outcome: The customer inquiry is handled efficiently with proper context handoff, timely resolution or escalation of the issue, and accurate ticket status tracking, resulting in a satisfied customer without any system errors.

agents.description: Agent 1 handles the initial customer inquiry, collects necessary information, and forwards the request to Agent 2.
Agent 2 analyzes the issue, attempts resolution, and escalates complex issues to Agent 3 if needed.
Agent 3 tracks the ticket status, updates it as resolved or escalated, and ensures the customer is notified about the outcome.
